title: The Briar House papers
tagline: A stolen key. A silent house. Four pieces of evidence.
setting: An old country house, after dark
intro: An envelope arrives with no return address. Inside: a floor plan, four witness accounts, a torn photograph and a note asking you to reconstruct the last evening at Briar House. The puzzles form an anthology investigation; each chapter teaches a different kind of deduction.

chapters.name: Conflicting accounts
chapters.brief: Start with the statements. Only the specified number can be true.

chapters.name: The duplicate key
chapters.brief: Match people, rooms and objects to identify the key’s carrier.

chapters.name: The torn photograph
chapters.brief: Rebuild the shape left in the photograph.

chapters.name: The last room
chapters.brief: Place everyone on the floor plan, then name the murderer.

ending: You have reconstructed the house’s four records: statements, possessions, a photograph and the final scene. The investigation is complete. Every puzzle remains available for another look.

title: The midnight departure
tagline: A stopped clock. A lost signal. Nobody leaves yet.
setting: An overnight train on the coast
intro: The night train stops between stations. You have four records from the carriage and its signal box. Restore the signal, trace a route, compare the statements, then reconstruct the carriage. Each record is a standalone logic puzzle in this casebook.

chapters.name: A signal in the static
chapters.brief: Turn each tile until the whole network connects.

chapters.name: The conductor’s route
chapters.brief: Follow the numbers through every square.

chapters.name: The clockless room
chapters.brief: Test the witnesses’ accounts against the truth count.

chapters.name: A quiet carriage
chapters.brief: Rebuild the scene before the train departs.

ending: The records are in order and the signal is clear. You have completed the midnight departure casebook.

title: Secrets under glass
tagline: Follow the water. Turn on the lights. Find the truth.
intro: The conservatory caretaker has left four puzzles among the records. The water levels and lighting plan are the first pieces. An inventory and a floor plan complete the file. Solve them in sequence or open any chapter.

chapters.name: The tide room
chapters.brief: Fill the glass tanks to match the edge clues.

chapters.name: Paper lanterns
chapters.brief: Light every floor tile without crossing beams.

chapters.name: The violet envelope
chapters.brief: Make the connections in the inventory.

chapters.name: The locked conservatory
chapters.brief: Place the five people and close the case.

ending: Water, light, inventory and floor plan: the conservatory file is complete. The casebook is ready to archive.
